start_conditions.runner: Node runtime schema validation; no TypeScript compile claim
start_conditions.runtime_requirement: record exact Node/npm versions on each run

scenario.name: Optional settings contract survives dependency upgrade
scenario.action: User selects supported synthetic Zod fixture, confirms versions and requirement, starts upgrade verification, reviews generated source patch and same-input recheck.
claims: preserve the fixed contract on specified inputs

expect: baseline/upgraded/patched per-case actual and explicit environment
same inputs evaluated after applying patch
commands, exit codes and actual errors

guard_scenarios.name: Installation or execution unavailable
guard_scenarios.expected: INFRA ERROR; no success badge; preserve actual error; distinguish from assertion failure

guard_scenarios.name: Model changes oracle/test/evaluator or returns invalid patch
guard_scenarios.expected: MODEL ERROR or explicit patch rejection; refuse success; preserve original bytes

guard_scenarios.name: Missing independent requirement
guard_scenarios.expected: UNVERIFIED; do not substitute model guess or observed output for expected

verdict_rules.PASS: All fixed expectations and invariants satisfied with genuine generated-patch execution and complete per-surface evidence. Automatic patch claim requires actual model generation; Daytona claim requires actual sponsor execution.
verdict_rules.PRODUCT FAIL: Oracle valid and infra/model normal but behavior, patch, or presentation violates expected.
verdict_rules.MODEL ERROR: Invalid generation prevents valid evaluation, including unauthorized patch scope.
verdict_rules.ORACLE INVALID / UNVERIFIED: Independent oracle is invalid or missing; not a detected regression.
verdict_rules.NOT_RUN: No actual product run; never count as PASS.

historical_reference.scope: Prior local manual schema comparison; no AI, PR or Daytona execution.

rerun.state: Product not implemented. Bind source SHAs and lockfile hashes before first product run, without changing the oracle.
rerun.historical_spike: Scratch fixture npm run verify is feasibility reproduction only, not this product contract execution.

excluded: Nosana/Daytona use without actual integration evidence
static mockup as live product evidence
fallback: Show historical local evidence or replay only with LOCAL / MANUAL / RECORDED labels; never present as live AI/sponsor PASS.
freeze_policy: Do not modify expected to fit later output. If oracle invalid, retain old version/reason and isolate this scenario; no PASS resurrection in this event.
